metrics: Arraya Solutions cuts costs by 50% with Data-Driven's CloudMonitor, built on Microsoft products

Arraya Solutions, a managed service provider for Microsoft Azure, was looking for ways to enhance its internal systems so it could share these strategies with its clients. Working with Microsoft partner Data-Driven, Arraya Solutions installed CloudMonitor into its Azure tenancy. CloudMonitor furnished cost analytics via Microsoft Power BI, ultimately allowing Arraya Solutions to achieve cost savings of 50 percent. Arraya Solutions then extended this approach to its clients, spotlighting trends, recommendations, and additional meta details about their Azure resources, resulting in an average cost reduction of 15 percent to 20 percent.

By incorporating the changes in company culture alongside CloudMonitor, Arraya managed to achieve savings of 50 percent. The company was subsequently able to undertake projects without concerns of being overwhelmed by rising costs. Arraya extended the same strategy to its clients, and on average, this aided customers in reducing costs by 15 percent to 20 percent, enabling them to allocate the savings toward other initiatives. This approach also contributed to maintaining a financially sound environment.
